svg.title: ChemoPress pin configuration — Arduino Uno + 2x L298N + MPRLS I2C
svg.desc: Complete wiring diagram showing Arduino Uno connected to two L298N motor drivers for 3 DC pumps and MPRLS pressure sensor via I2C
svg.text: connect ALL GND pins on both L298N boards — missing even one causes overheating
pump power from power bank directly to VCC2 — never through Arduino 5V pin
